{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Tutorial2026Icon.png]] |-|Icon = [[File:TutorialBanner.png]] |map = [[Tutorial]] |waves = 5 |starting_cash = {{Money|1,500}} |rewards = {{Coins|150}} & {{Exp|75}} |chapter = TDS: Boot Camp |previous_mission = [[Live Fire]] |next_mission = [[Brute Force]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Build without placement rails, counter mixed enemy traits, and defeat your first boss.|In-game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Breach Protocol''' is the third mission for the tutorial chapter of the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The loadout for this map is set to be the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]] and [[Demoman]]. Sell cost of all towers is also 100% of their total price. Base health is set to infinity and [[Skills]] are disabled. ==Rewards== '''Breach Protocol''' gives a one time reward of {{Coins|150}} and {{Exp|75}}.
